No, that on its own isn't covered. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks after delivery is normal transplant stress. The guarantee lasts 30 days from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members), and it applies if the plant dies or declines significantly. That means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.

For now, keep it out of direct sun during its first week and don't repot for 2-3 weeks. Water only when the top inch of soil is dry, since overwatering is the most common early problem.

If it gets worse within your window, submit a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist reviews claims within 2 business days. You can also chat or email a specialist for free care advice anytime.
